instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say whether a person is a member of a shared space right now, and why not when they are not", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-someone-is-in-a-space and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The one answer to whether a person is a member now.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:space (records:read); record:space-member (records:read); payment-event (records:list); record:commercial-offer (records:list); access-grant (records:list); access-effect-rule (records:list); effect-lifecycle (records:list).
